TextView.android:text: By downloading, installing, or using Noti Reader ("the App"), you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions ("Terms"). If you do not agree to these Terms, do not use the App.\n\nNoti Reader is an independent third-party application developed to help users recover and backup WhatsApp messages through notification reading services. We are not affiliated with WhatsApp Inc. or Meta Platforms, Inc.

Noti Reader provides the following services:

• Notification Reading Service: Monitors WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business notifications to capture message content before deletion
• Message Recovery: Stores received messages locally to prevent data loss
• Media Backup: Automatically saves media files (photos, videos, documents, voice notes, stickers, GIFs) shared in WhatsApp conversations
• Conversation Management: Organizes messages by sender for easy access and review
• Dual Platform Support: Works with both personal WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business applications
• Local Storage: All data is stored locally on your device using Android's secure storage system
• Premium Features: Optional ad-free experience through in-app purchases

Data Processing Activities:
• Reading WhatsApp notification content (messages, sender names, timestamps)
• Extracting media file information from notifications
• Storing message data locally using Android Room Database
• Copying media files to app-specific directories
• Processing notification metadata for organization purposes
• Storing user preferences and app settings

Data Storage:
